Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the song. While the user asked for the fifth single from the sixth studio album ("Bad"), the WebSurfer falsely concluded in its second turn that "Dirty Diana" was the fifth single. In reality, the fifth single from "Bad" is "Speed Demon" (released in 1988), while "Dirty Diana" was the third single. This fundamental error in discography lookup led the entire subsequent analysis of lyrics to be based on the wrong song, resulting in an incorrect answer.
